Maya: Quick Q — Tarmac SI (APAC) claimed a marketplace lead via Handshake. Who owns the follow-up when CRM already has a Field owner?
Frank: Rule today is: ACV < $50k => partner-led; ACV >= $50k => sales-led. But we need explicit windows and override rules.
Anya: Suggestion: partner-exclusive claim window = 24h after claim, field response window = 48h, then route to Sales Intake. Exceptions: accounts tagged "strategic" or "co-sell" require manual ops review.
Raj: I'll draft config vars: partner_window, field_window, priority_weights. Pseudo-rule: if crm_owner -> keep crm_owner; elif partner_assigned and partner_priority >= threshold -> give partner; elif marketplace_claim within partner_window -> give partner; else -> route to intake_queue.
Leo: Precedence order in CRM should be authoritative: internal_owner > crm_assigned_partner > marketplace_claim > orphan. Handshake automation must consult CRM mapping first.
Maya: What about multi-partner conflicts? e.g., hardware distributor and SI both claim same account.
Frank: We'll enforce single-claim lock. If multi-claims, higher priority partner wins; otherwise escalate to partnership_ops for adjudication within 8 hours.
HandshakeBot: Claim recorded: partner=tarmac-si, account=akamai-inc, lead_id=LD-9983, status=pending, ts=2025-03-17T14:02:10Z
Raj: Ops plan: publish region-specific windows (APAC shorter window for timezone overlap), add partner_priority numeric field (1-100), and expose a manual override flag for "strategic" accounts.
Anya: Also need a handoff checklist on the intake ticket: partner SE assigned, joint slide deck, quote draft, marketplace listing date, legal sign-off. No external joint announcement before exec alignment + legal. Recommend 2-week embargo after sign-off.
Maya: Can someone draft a one-pager for AEs/AMs summarizing claim rules, priority, and handoff checklist?
Anya: On it. Will post draft by EOD tomorrow.
Frank: I'll own the APAC pilot; Raj will implement region configs and post a change note in #partnerships.
Raj: Confirmed. Ticket HB-4711 created for automation work. Will post rollout notes.
Maya: Thanks all :thumbsup:
